archive.note: Archive members were listed and checksum-compared. They were not extracted into the training table.

pianda-cp-reduced-m42.reason: Source-native Pianda CompetenceMean (C1–C10) and PsyCapMean (PsyCap1–PsyCap14). UCC 10-item C/P means are not measurement-equivalent.

pianda-cp-internship-expanded-m42.reason: Expanded source-native comparison. InternshipMean is the Pianda SIE1–SIE14 mean. EduPredict stores an internship count, not that 14-item scale.

uci-scholarship-only-m42.reason: UCI Scholarship holder is 0/1. EduPredict scholarship_status categories and missing-profile coercion are not verified equivalents.

uci-first-sem-units-m42.reason: Source-native first-semester enrolled and approved unit counts. UCC subject-unit totals have no verified first-semester index or approval definition. Grade columns are excluded.

uci-two-sem-units-m42.reason: Source-native first- and second-semester enrolled and approved counts. Using second-semester results for an earlier prediction is leakage. UCC term identity is unverified. Grade columns are excluded.
